content: The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others.
author: Mahatma Gandhi
sourceWork: Ethical Religion / Speeches of Mahatma Gandhi
explanation:
Modern culture obsesses over hyper-individualistic self-discovery, encouraging people to endlessly gaze into the mirror of their own anxieties, desires, and personal branding. Yet the more we isolate the ego, the emptier we feel. Gandhi discovered that real identity and spiritual clarity are unlocked precisely when you forget your petty personal drama and pour your energy into relieving another person's burden.

In selfless service, the isolating walls of the ego crumble, revealing the expansive, joyful essence of who you truly are.
practicalInsight: Step outside your personal loop of concerns today by performing an act of service or support for someone who can offer you nothing in return.
reflectionPrompt: When was the last time you were so immersed in helping another person that all your personal worries completely vanished?
